title: DependencyGraph
description: Module-level (file-to-file) import graph built by dependency-graph.mjs from static import/require statements. Deliberately scoped to MODULE-level edges, not function-level call graphs — a real symbol/call graph needs a real AST parser, which this dependency-free pack does not vendor; this is documented as a known scope boundary (see the module's own header comment), not silently pretended to be more than it is.

unresolvedImports.description: Import specifiers that couldn't be resolved to a file in the repo (external packages, or a resolution this regex-based extractor doesn't handle) — reported explicitly rather than silently dropped.
